steps.operation: enter surface with same action ID
introduce connected group G1 as A2
join and adjust A1 and A2

scenarios.name: cancel-after-other-commit
scenarios.expected: Clear only own overlay and display latest canonical board; no charge and no stale restore.

scenarios.name: stale-confirm
scenarios.expected: Reject the entire batch; board version and committed allowance do not change.

scenarios.name: lost-confirm-response
scenarios.expected: Unknown until the original identity and command ID resolve. Retrying the identical payload cannot charge twice; a changed payload conflicts.

scenarios.name: admitted-before-utc-close
scenarios.expected: The admitted command may commit to the old puzzle; resolve its original ID against that puzzle.

scenarios.name: unadmitted-at-utc-close
scenarios.expected: Clear the old preview without committed charge; missing new content is unavailable.

scenarios.name: move-and-rotate-correct-assembled-group
scenarios.expected: Before completion, moving or rotating the connected group introduces one counted action; preview does not change canonical final-position flags or progress. Confirm recomputes final-position flags; completion behavior remains under review.
